name: Sandwich and Sauer--Shelah Bounds
statement: For every finite Boolean class $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, the strongly shattered and shattered complexes satisfy $|\operatorname{sstr}(H)|\le|H|\le|\operatorname{str}(H)|$. Consequently, if $|X|=n$ and $\operatorname{VCdim}(H)=d$, then $|H|\le\sum_{i=0}^d\binom ni$. The cardinality bound is sharp, attained by $\binom{X}{\le d}$.
